question: The trial test of a computer or software before the commercial launch is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beta test.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beta test**

 
 
• A beta test is a type of trial period for a computer product prior to a commercial or official release.
 
• Beta testing is considered the last stage of testing before launch.
 
• It normally involves the distribution of the product to external beta test sites and individual users for real-world exposure.
 
• Other beta tests may offer the product for a free trial download over the Internet.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alpha test**

 
 
• Alpha testing is the first end-to-end testing of a product to ensure it meets the business requirements and functions correctly.
 
• It is typically performed by internal employees and conducted in a lab/stage environment.
 
• An alpha test ensures the product really works and does everything it's supposed to do.
 
 
 
• **Delta test**
 
 
• Delta testing is automated user testing.
 
• It's a proven, cost-effective approach to legacy user testing that allows companies to capture early product feedback from customers.
 
• This gives companies the customer insights they need to develop high-quality products their customers will love.
